messages.subject: Planned DMS maintenance - Saturday 24 January
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The document management system (NetDocuments) will be unavailable from 20:00 Saturday 24 January until 02:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance. Please save and check in any open documents beforehand. Email and Teams are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
